content.value: Identify true or false from following underlined questions:
i) Needle are thin metal plats drilled with hollow in their lower end through which a warp end may be threaded.
ii) Conesare used in warp knitting machine.
iii) Pattern wheel pullsthe guide bar away from pattern mechanism. So underlap is produced.
iv) Push rod pushes the needle bar.
v) C’ means that both fork and tail are ground.
vi) Wire take down the fabrics in a certain width.
vii) There are 4 basic overlap/ underlap variations.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2017
